messages.subject: New commercial deal - Brookmere Asset Management
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

We're close to terms with Brookmere Asset Management plc for an enterprise subscription to the platform plus a data licence. They're a large institutional manager (~£42bn AUM) and want it on a master agreement with full SLA and DPA. Could Whitfield Carter take the drafting and negotiation? Their lawyers are Denham Lewis.

Target is signature before our financial year-end in late January.

Thanks,
Sofia

messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia,

Delighted to help. James Osei will lead day to day with Elena Marchetti; I'll keep partner oversight. Our engagement letter is attached - scope is the MSA and schedules (order form, SLA, DPA, data licence) through to execution. Fee estimate £28k-£38k plus VAT.

If you countersign and return we'll get the first draft to you this week.

Best,
Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
